phases.name: Device Pocket Healing & Lead Protection
phases.clinical_note: Do not raise affected arm above shoulder level for 4 weeks to prevent lead displacement

advance_criteria.description: Device pocket clean, no lead dislodgement, HR pacing verified

meals.name: Nutrient-Dense Breakfast
meals.notes: Warm oatmeal with berries and almond butter

meals.name: Balanced Protein Lunch
meals.notes: Quinoa bowl with beans, roasted vegetables

meals.name: Restorative Dinner
meals.notes: Baked fish or tofu, steamed sweet potato and greens

instructions: Do NOT raise operative arm above shoulder level
Do not lift more than 5 lbs with operative side
Gentle flat walking: 15 minutes twice daily

checks.name: Pacemaker Pocket Site
checks.target: Subclavicular incision clean, dry, no swelling or discharge

checks.name: Resting Heart Rate Check
checks.target: Verify heart rate does not drop below programmed lower rate

templates.focus_note: Protect the device pocket and prevent movement that could displace newly placed leads.
